note: Rejudged 2026-10-31 by an auditor who authored none of the change. RFC 5303 Section 3.1: "Any system that supports this mechanism MUST include the Adjacency Three-Way State field in this option." b77067bc31 changed only the call sites in this unit: threeWayTLV and buildP2PHello now take a p2pNeighbor (systemID, extendedCircuitID) instead of a bare SystemID, with the zero value where none was passed before; every assertion is byte-identical and an independent judge approved the change. Verdict unchanged. Earlier judgment follows. Forbidden: a TLV 240 without the Adjacency Three-Way State field. internal/plugins/isis/circuit/rfc5303_threeway_test.go::TestISISP2PThreeWayStateFieldIncluded: for Up, Initializing and Down the emitted value is non-empty and decodes to the same state (Fatalf otherwise); negative internal/plugins/isis/circuit/rfc5303_threeway_test.go::TestISISP2PThreeWayStateFieldPresentWithoutNeighbor: the minimal no-neighbor form still carries it.
